title: Review round 1: Deployment packaging
description: Review round 1 for KITH-jh7 epic. Covers: contrib/systemd/kithd.service, contrib/systemd/kithd@.service, contrib/README.md, crates/kithd/src/main.rs (first-run changes), crates/kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs (SelfPeer), crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs (is_first_run).
notes:
SEC1 Review Complete: 3 P1 maintainer burden issues identified:

1. Tailscale UserID deserialization lacks explicit error distinction (KITH-m55.2)
2. systemd unit files have no validation against config.rs changes (KITH-m55.3)  
3. Environment variable documentation fragmented across 4 files (KITH-m55.4)

All three stem from **lack of automation** — documentation and configuration files manually maintained in sync with code. No tooling detects drift. 

Assessment: These are not bugs in the code today, but maintainer burden risks that will surface in future refactors. Mitigation is possible (tests, generated docs, pre-commit hooks) but requires upfront investment.

For Phase 1 MVP: Code is sound and safe. These issues do not block deployment but should be addressed before scaling to multi-user hosts or major refactors.
